frequency_source: OPUS OpenSubtitles v2024 Pashto frequencies https://object.pouta.csc.fi/OPUS-OpenSubtitles/v2024/freq/ps.freq.gz (FrequencyWords 2018 has no ps file). The list is modest in size compared with Arabic or Persian.
how_to_tell_apart: Pashto has a large set of letters that Arabic, Persian and Urdu do not use, notably ښ, ږ, ځ, څ, ې, ۍ, ټ and ڼ. Word cues include زه, تاسو, مننه, مهرباني, څه, څنګه, چیرته, ولې, سبا, ماښام and غواړم. Urdu would show ہوں/آپ/شکریہ and ے; Persian would show است/لطفا and پ/چ/ژ/گ without the Pashto-only letters. Short items such as د, او and نه occur in neighbouring languages and are not sufficient. The OpenSubtitles Pashto list is relatively small, so mid-frequency ranks should be treated with more caution than for Arabic.

uncertain: The OpenSubtitles Pashto frequency list is small, and some lines may mix Dari or Urdu; distinctive letters and the pronouns زه/تاسو were preferred for that reason.
Regional dialect differences (northern versus southern pronunciation of ښ, and some verb forms) are not fully visible in a short word list.
